title: Hello
description: The first message each way on a screen socket: the server says what it offers, and the client answers with the encodings it decodes, most preferred first.

ServerHello.description: What the server offers, sent as soon as the socket is admitted.

server.description: The server's name and version, such as sim-mirror/0.1.0.

connector.description: The connector driving the device, such as idb or simctl.

fallback_reason.description: Why a connector other than the one asked for is in use; null otherwise.

ClientHello.description: The client's answer: the encodings it decodes, most preferred first. A server ignores encodings it does not know.
